content.short: Moralis is a leading Web3 data provider offering real-time blockchain data APIs, managed RPC nodes, and developer tools for building on Mantle.
content.description: Moralis is a comprehensive Web3 data infrastructure platform offering a suite of APIs for token data, wallet activity, NFT metadata, DeFi positions, and blockchain events across dozens of networks. The platform also provides managed RPC nodes (Moralis Nodes) for reliable blockchain access. Supporting Mantle with full data indexing and node services, Moralis enables developers to build performant dApps without the complexity of managing blockchain infrastructure.
content.meta: Moralis provides blockchain data APIs and node infrastructure for building Web3 apps on Mantle. Discover Moralis on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
